typography.rationale: Playfair Display brings a tactile, editorial, gallery-like premium warmth suited for architectural spaces. Manrope is a geometric sans that is highly legible on cheaper Android devices, ensuring critical details like SKUs and dimensions are clear while avoiding the generic feel of Inter or Roboto.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-medium

usage_rules.background: Bone (#F6F1EA) - Default page and section background. Replaces pure white in most places to maintain warmth.
usage_rules.surface: Warm greige (#E4D9C8) - Used for structural elements like cards, image placeholders, dividers, and inactive filter chips.
usage_rules.text_primary: Charcoal-brown (#2B2621) - Primary text for headings, body copy, and active nav items. Warmer than pure black.
usage_rules.text_secondary: Muted taupe (#6B6259) - Used for metadata, captions, secondary details, and inactive nav items.
usage_rules.accent_primary: Clay/terracotta (#B5602F) - The site's functional identity. Used for ALL primary CTAs, active states, active filter chips, links, and hover states.
usage_rules.accent_secondary: Kajaria blue (#15508B) - STRICT GUARDRAIL: Used ONLY for the 'Authorized Kajaria Dealer' badge in the trust strip and footer. Nowhere else.
usage_rules.whatsapp_green: WhatsApp Green (#25D366) - Exempt from the 2-accent rule. Used strictly for the sticky WhatsApp bar and WhatsApp CTA buttons to trigger instant brand recognition.

layouts.grid_system: Bento-inspired, mobile-first responsive grid. Prioritize vertical rhythm. Use gap-4 on mobile and gap-8 on desktop.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8 for containers and py-16, py-24 for main sections to create an uncluttered, gallery-like feel where photos can breathe.
layouts.sparse_data_handling: Room category grids must use CSS grid with auto-fill minmax(250px, 1fr) to gracefully scale from 3 to 40 items without leaving awkward empty spaces or breaking the layout.
layouts.hero_section: Photography-dominant, full-bleed hero. Overlay text with responsive charcoal/white depending on image darkness. Single Clay CTA button. NO Blue.

buttons.primary: bg-[#B5602F] text-[#F6F1EA] hover:bg-[#944c23] rounded-md transition-colors px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.whatsapp: bg-[#25D366] text-white rounded-md hover:bg-[#20bd5a] transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#E4D9C8] text-[#2B2621] hover:border-[#B5602F] rounded-md transition-colors px-6 py-3 font-medium

cards.product_card: bg-[#F6F1EA] md:bg-white border border-[#E4D9C8] rounded-md overflow-hidden hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300
cards.pills: Material badges (PVT/GVT/Ceramic) are small clay-tinted pills (bg-[#B5602F]/10 text-[#B5602F]). Filter chips at rest are greige (bg-[#E4D9C8] text-[#2B2621]), active are clay.

components.navigation: Bone background (#F6F1EA), charcoal wordmark. Clay underline on active/hover items. NO blue. Always use backdrop-blur-md if sticky.
components.trust_strip: Bone or white background strip. Contains 'Authorized Kajaria Dealer' lockup in #15508B, treated like a certification mark.
components.sticky_whatsapp_bar: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 bg-[#F6F1EA]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-[#E4D9C8] z-50 flex justify-center items-center shadow-[0_-4px_6px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]. Must contain a pre-filled WhatsApp deep link with tile name + SKU.

motion.philosophy: Restrained, elegant, gallery-like. No bouncy, hyperactive, or excessive animations.
motion.interactions: Subtle hover lifts (-translate-y-1) for product cards. Smooth opacity fade-ins for images.
motion.framer_motion: Use `framer-motion` for staggered entrance of gallery grid items (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0). Duration 0.4s ease-out.

media.style: Large, immersive imagery. Photos are the product. No color overlays or tints on gallery images. Use Lightbox for full view.

accessibility.contrast: All text holds at least 4.5:1 contrast against its background.
accessibility.interactive: All buttons and links must have focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#B5602F] focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#F6F1EA]).
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements, e.g., `data-testid="whatsapp-cta-button"`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 2-accent rule: Clay (#B5602F) for UI identity and actions, Blue (#15508B) EXCLUSIVELY for the Kajaria Dealer trust badge.
Implement the Sticky WhatsApp bar at the bottom for mobile devices, ensuring it uses pre-filled deep links containing the specific Tile Name and SKU.
Build the public marketing and catalogue pages using raw HTML + Tailwind for custom, unconstrained layout freedom. Avoid rigidly dropping in standard Shadcn components for marketing presentation.
Use standard CSS grid with `auto-fill` and `minmax()` for product/gallery grids to ensure they look intentional even if there are only 3 items.

Use Shadcn components exclusively in the protected Admin Panel (CRUD operations, drag-and-drop multi-image upload). Keep the admin panel strictly functional with the brand's neutral colors (#F6F1EA, #E4D9C8, #2B2621).
Do not use transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; it causes text collision. Use `bg-[#F6F1EA]/90 backdrop-blur-md` instead.
Ensure image lazy-loading is implemented since the site targets cheap Android phones on mobile data.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic by relying on generous negative space and the specific Playfair Display + Manrope typography pairing.
Do not center-align body copy. Left-align text to respect the natural reading flow.
Avoid hyper-stylized borders or glowing neons. Stick to flat, tactile colors defined in the palette.
Never use generic placeholder images or missing image icons. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Always apply hover, active, and focus states. An interface without micro-interactions feels broken.
Use 2x-3x more spacing (p-8, py-20, gap-8) than feels standard. Cramped interfaces destroy the 'premium showroom' illusion.
